reason: The deterministic PHPStan gate failed on Linux because ProcessRunner chose the Windows Composer .bat wrapper before the executable binary. The owner-side fix is validated, and this is a repeatable host-boundary lesson that belongs in a LearningNote rather than a new active constraint.
remaining_uncertainty: The source Finding also mentions linked-worktree hook behavior; that is a separate filesystem/configuration boundary and is intentionally not folded into this proposal.
new: When invoking a Composer-provided executable through proc_open, select the host-appropriate extensionless wrapper before Windows .bat files; a file that exists is not necessarily executable on the current host.
boundary: Applies to host-side process selection for Composer binaries. It does not change provider-specific command discovery or validate arbitrary third-party executables beyond the selected host wrapper.
scope_justification: The deterministic PHPStan gate failed on Linux because ProcessRunner chose the Windows Composer .bat wrapper before the executable binary. The owner-side fix is validated, and this is a repeatable host-boundary lesson that belongs in a LearningNote rather than a new active constraint.

validation_case.given: a Composer bin directory containing both an extensionless executable and a Windows .bat wrapper
validation_case.when: a Linux process runner selects the first existing candidate without checking host compatibility
validation_case.then: proc_open can fail with Exec format error, so the runner selects the host-appropriate executable before invoking it
